command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
cd /tmp
printf '3c9c466a2e1776c104108a9f6348708c1cf0d347d6057cbfaac6edb16d9ffe5c  fetch.py\n' > scripts.sha256
sha256sum -c scripts.sha256 || { echo 'FAIL: a staged script does not match its pin'; exit 1; }
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out
python3 -u fetch.py 10000000 10099999 /tmp/out 2>&1 | tee /tmp/out/fetch.log
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = 0 || { echo 'FAIL: fetch'; exit 1; }
(cd /tmp/out/ewt && sha256sum * > /tmp/out/ewt.sha256)
cat /tmp/out/ewt.sha256
du -sh /tmp/out/*
echo DONE
